marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Strawberry Shortcake adventures on Ice Cream Island

Horse of a different color: When Honey Pie pony meets other horses on Ice Cream Island, she thinks she should move there. But once she realizes how much her human pals need her back home, she reconsiders. The festival of the fillies: Honey Pie is thrilled to join in the annual festivities on Ice Cream Island. After she attracts the attention of a nasty horse show owner, though, the kids must work together to keep her - and the other horses - out of his reach
